question: Which team won the Khelo India Para Games 2023 held in New Delhi in December 2023?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Haryana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Haryana** emerged as the champion of the **Khelo India Para Games 2023**, showcasing outstanding performances by its athletes.
 
• The event was held in **New Delhi** in December 2023 and aimed to promote inclusivity and provide a platform for para-athletes to display their talent.
 
• Haryana is known for its strong emphasis on sports and has consistently produced top athletes in various disciplines, including **para-sports**.
 
• The state's para-athletes excelled in multiple events, contributing significantly to Haryana's overall medal tally.
 
• The **Khelo India Para Games** is a part of the larger **Khelo India initiative**, launched by the Government of India to promote sports at the grassroots level and nurture young talent.
 
• The event featured a variety of sports tailored to the abilities of para-athletes, including **athletics, swimming, badminton, and wheelchair basketball**.
 
• Haryana's victory highlights the state's commitment to fostering sports infrastructure and providing support to athletes with disabilities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Gujarat**__

 __
 
• **Gujarat** is known for its initiatives in promoting sports, including hosting major events like the **National Games of India 2022**.
 
• However, it did not secure the top position in the **Khelo India Para Games 2023**.
 
 
 
• **Uttar Pradesh**__
 __
 
• **Uttar Pradesh** has been actively working to enhance its sports infrastructure and has produced many talented athletes over the years.
 
• While the state performed well, it could not surpass Haryana in the medal tally at the **Khelo India Para Games 2023**.
 
 
 
• **Tamil Nadu**__
 
 
• **Tamil Nadu** has a rich history of supporting para-athletes and promoting inclusivity in sports.
 
• Despite its efforts and participation, the state did not achieve the top spot in this edition of the games.
